source.name: CDC NCHS — provisional county drug overdose deaths

popSource.name: US Census Bureau — county population estimates, vintage 2024

caveats: Provisional counts. They lag by several months and are revised upward as investigations close.
A 12-month rolling total, not a monthly count.
Counts of 1 to 9 are suppressed for confidentiality. Suppressed is not zero.
Deaths are counted where they occurred, which is not always where the person lived.
Rates use Census population estimates for 2024, a year earlier than the death window.
